listing.name: Girls' Frontline: Project Neural Cloud Portraits Pack
listing.summary: Contains 500+ portraits from characters of Girls' Frontline: Project Neural Cloud spinoff, added to your player faction and other vanilla factions. Also includes 19 flags from factions you encounter throughout the story. Should be safe to download and drop right into your modpack.
listing.aiSummary: Adds over 500 portraits and 19 flags from the Girls' Frontline: Project Neural Cloud spinoff to player and vanilla factions.

description:
Girls' Frontline: Project Neural Cloud Portraits Pack

DOWNLOAD LINK [v1.0.2]

Contains 500+ portraits from characters of Girls' Frontline: Project Neural Cloud spinoff, added to your player faction and other vanilla factions.
Also includes 19 flags from factions you encounter throughout the story.
Should be safe to download and drop right into your modpack. May induce lag should the entire pack be included.

Portraits Preview

"Male dolls do in fact, exist in the Girls' Frontline universe."

Flags Preview

Included Contents
Base Pack & Flags
Starlight Projections - Skins Pack
Endearing Dorks -  Miscellaneous Portraits Pack
Sanctified Agents - Notable Characters Pack

Does not contain content from collaborations between Girls' Frontline: Project Neural Cloud and other IPs
Certain elements were excluded from the pack as they would not be SFW, or are just orphans who would be committing saturation bombardments under your command.

Changelogs
(MM/DD/YY Format)
1.0.2 - 06/17/26
Added 12 flags for various sectors within Magrasea.

1.0.1 - 03/10/26
Added version checking support.
Added 5 portraits to the Base pack, for characters with accessories obscuring their face.

...It's just their Expanded projections, not rocket science or any spawn of Moloch's magic.
These modpacks are 100% compliant with Hegemony's AI Inspections.

1.0.0 - 01/31/26 - Initial Forums Release

Acknowledgements
All portraits were sourced from Girls' Frontline official artworks, and belongs to Sunborn / MICA Team.
Special thanks to "A Network Security Assistant" (they’ve opted to use a pseudonym for this) for helping me with the creation of this portraits pack.

You are not immune to Grand Starfall.
